At Ameriprise Financial, we’re not just in the business of helping clients with their financial goals – we also help our advisors and employees reach their true potential by embracing an inclusive and collaborative culture. We celebrate the unique qualities and reward the contributions of our talented, passionate employees. If you’re motivated and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares about you and your community, take the next step with Ameriprise Financial.

This position is with an Ameriprise Financial Franchise owner.

Job Description

Who We Are
Glades Wealth Partners is an award-winning wealth management team recognized by Forbes Best-in-State Wealth Management Teams (2025-2026) and the Ameriprise Client Experience Award (2021-2025). We are guided by our values of Community, Integrity, Clarity, and Teamwork and believe serious financial work can still be enjoyable.

We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Around here, exceptional client service, smart systems, and the occasional office-dog cameo all matter.

About the Role
We're looking for someone who appreciates strong processes, notices opportunities to make them even better, asks thoughtful questions, and helps turn good ideas into practical improvements.

Glades Wealth Partners is often selected for Ameriprise pilot programs and new technology initiatives. The right candidate will help evaluate new tools, drive adoption, and identify practical ways to make our team more efficient and effective.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just follow processes. We're looking for someone who improves them.

If you're naturally curious and frequently find yourself saying, "I know how we can improve this.” you'll fit right in!

What You'll Do

• Own calendar management for the entire team, including scheduling and rescheduling meetings, coordinating preparation and follow-up, and maintaining optimized, efficient, and accurate calendars
• Manage client service requests from start to finish
• Maintain accurate CRM records and workflows
• Serve as a key point of contact for client communications
• Support the evaluation, rollout, and adoption of new technology tools and Ameriprise pilot programs
• Spot process gaps, workflow misses, and inefficiencies—and help build practical solutions
• Support team training and technology adoption efforts

What Success Looks Like

• Clients receive an elevated experience, worthy of telling their friends about CRM records are accurate and up to date Identifies gaps, misses, and inefficiencies—and helps create practical solutions
• Stays current on new technology releases, evaluates their usefulness for our practice, and helps integrate the right tools into our workflow
• Processes and team calendars are accurate, organized, optimized, and efficient
• Team members view you as reliable, proactive, and solutions-oriented

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree
• 2+ years of professional experience
• Strong organizational, calendar management, and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple schedules and priorities accurately
• Brings a solution-oriented mindset and a sharp eye for details others may miss
• A work-smarter-not-harder mindset, with a natural drive to simplify and improve how work gets done
• Confidence learning new technology, evaluating how it fits the practice, and helping others adopt it
• Comfortable asking thoughtful questions, identifying what may have been missed, and following through on solutions
• Experience with CRM systems and Microsoft 365

Preferred

• Financial services experience
• Salesforce experience
• Microsoft Copilot Premium or Claude experience
• Process improvement or project coordination experience

Why Join Us?

• Award-winning, client-focused team
• Direct impact on how our business grows and evolves
• Opportunities to work with emerging technology and innovation pilots
• Training, mentorship, and professional development
• Collaborative culture with high standards and a sense of humor
• Quarterly team outings
• Dog-friendly, animal-loving team culture

Benefits

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• SIMPLE IRA with employer contribution
• Paid time off and paid holidays
• Short- and long-term disability insurance
• Continuing education and licensing support
• On-site workout room and shower

Full-Time/Part-Time

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

팀 소개

About the Team

The Safety Systems team https://openai.com/safety/safety-systems is responsible for various safety work to ensure our best models can be safely deployed to the real world to benefit the society, and is at the forefront of OpenAI's mission to build and deploy safe AGI, driving our commitment to AI safety and fostering a culture of trust and transparency.

The Safety Oversight Research team aims to fundamentally advance our capabilities to maintain oversight over frontier AI models, and leverage these advances to ensure OpenAI’s deployed models are safe and beneficial. This requires a breadth of new ML research in the areas of human-AI collaboration, reasoning, robustness, and scalable oversight to keep pace with model capabilities. We invest heavily in developing novel model and system-level methods of identifying and mitigating AI misuse and misalignment.

Our goal is to learn from deployment and distribute the benefits of AI, while ensuring that this powerful tool is used responsibly and safely.

About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a senior researcher with a passion for AI safety and experience in safety research. Your role will set directions for research to maintain effective oversight of safe AGI and work on research projects to identify and mitigate misuse and misalignment in our AI systems. You will play a critical role in defining how a safe AI system should look in the future at OpenAI, making a significant impact on our mission to build and deploy safe AGI.

In this role, you will:

- Develop and refine AI monitor models to detect and mitigate known and emerging patterns of misuse and misalignment.

- Set research directions and strategies to make our AI systems safer, more aligned, and more robust.

- Evaluate and design effective red-teaming pipelines to examine the end-to-end robustness of our safety systems, and identify areas for future improvement.

- Conduct research to improve models’ ability to reason about questions of human values, and apply these improved models to practical safety challenges.

- Coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including T&S, legal, policy and other research teams, to ensure that our products meet the highest safety standards.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Are excited about OpenAI’s mission https://openai.com/mission/ of building safe, universally beneficial AGI and are aligned with OpenAI’s charter https://openai.com/charter/

- Show enthusiasm for AI safety and dedication to enhancing the safety of cutting-edge AI models for real-world use.

- Bring 4+ years of experience in the field of AI safety, especially in areas like RLHF, human-AI collaboration, fairness & biases.

- Hold a Ph.D. or other degree in computer science, machine learning, or a related field.

- Thrive in environments involving large-scale AI systems.

Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Join Tripledot Studios as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer working on dynamic pricing and recommender systems use cases in our games. The work involves tabular machine learning, including neural networks and approaches such as gradient-boosted decision trees. You'll focus on understanding the data, developing features and improving the models, rather than primarily owning production deployment.

You'll work toward defined near-term ML targetds, collaborating with the monetization team and game product teams to plan A/B tests. Over the longer term, you'll work with those teams to translate product and monetization requirements into ML objectives.

You'll start by learning the project and its business goals. Within the first three months, we'd expect you to contribute to the training pipeline and investigate features and model issues. By around six months, the aim is for you to take a more proactive role in setting the model's direction.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and improve training pipelines for dynamic pricing and recommender system models, from feature and label design through training, tuning and offline evaluation of tabular models such as neural networks and gradient-boosted trees.
• Monitor model performance once models are live across games and products. Investigate data and concept drift, including shifts tied to new titles, client versions or user behaviour, and make models easier to extend to another product.
• Diagnose missed model outcomes across the training pipeline, business logic and underlying data, then work through the improvements needed to restore model quality.
• Work with monetization and product colleagues to connect model decisions to revenue and player outcomes, and help plan the A/B tests that inform what ships.
• As you get up to speed, identify gaps in the team's understanding of the models and propose improvements to their direction.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Hands-on training and evaluation of tabular models, using neural networks or gradient-boosted trees. Experience with PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, TensorFlow, XGBoost, CatBoost or scikit-learn could all be relevant; no single framework is required.
• Experience designing features and labels, choosing metrics for the decision a model makes and judging when offline results warrant an A/B test.
• Proficiency in SQL and the ability to write efficient queries to extract, manipulate and aggregate data from relational databases.
• An investigative approach to incomplete data and longer-term requirements that need clarification.
• The ability to explain model results to monetization and product partners in terms of revenue and player outcomes.
• Experience in ad tech, recommender systems or online marketplaces would be useful, as would experience with production APIs or deploying ML models. Experience with the Ray framework would also be a plus. None of these is required for the role.
• Uses AI-assisted development tools, including code assistants and LLM-based copilots, to accelerate implementation, debugging and iteration of machine learning systems while maintaining production-quality standards.
• Critically reviews and validates AI-generated code, model implementations and infrastructure configurations for reliability, correctness and maintainability, and explores AI-powered approaches to improve developer productivity or ML platform capability.

jobs.description: Intuit is looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to own the data and platform layer beneath our consumer risk decisioning. This team builds the machine learning that decides, in real time, whether money moves — protecting customers from account takeover, first/third-party fraud, and unauthorized transactions across Intuit Fintech products. You'll design and own the shared infrastructure every model on this team depends on: streaming and batch feature pipelines, the cross-entity data path, training and evaluation frameworks, real-time inference serving, and the handoff into our decision engine, across entire Fintech money product lifecycle — from risk screening/qualification of money-in/out events, cashflow underwriting, account take-over detection, to dynamic segmentation. What you architect becomes the reference pattern the whole organization adopts. Responsibilities Own the technical vision and architecture for the consumer risk data and serving platform — feature pipelines, the cross-entity data path, training and evaluation infrastructure, and real-time inference — balancing tradeoffs and long-term implications Design and build multi-cloud infrastructure stack and enable data handshake, working through federated account link mapping, and land curated, governed datasets in the Intuit's central data lake Build shared feature infrastructure spanning streaming and batch, consumed by multiple model workstreams, with the observability to catch drift and staleness Establish evaluation frameworks that make model quality, regression, and production impact measurable across the team's portfolio Own the model-to-decision path: deployment through model serving, integration with the decision engine, and correctness and latency on a sub-second decision budget Set and enforce engineering standards for ML systems on this team — testing, observability, reproducibility, operational excellence — and structure codebases for agent-assisted development and autonomous navigation Engineer closed-loop workflows that automate the repetitive parts of the model lifecycle, moving beyond point automation toward orchestrated systems needing minimal intervention Eliminate barriers caused by technical and prioritization complexity, including dependencies that cross into platform and data teams — cultivate the partnerships that make those dependencies tractable Generalize what you build into a reference pattern other teams can adopt rather than rebuild, and document it so the pattern travels Mentor engineers on ML systems craft; provide actionable feedback to senior engineers and help them break work into pieces agents can execute reliably Connect technical decisions to the metrics leadership tracks — loss basis points, approval rate, decision latency, hold release rate — define success up front, and drive the post-launch iteration Qualifications Minimum BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience 8+ years building production software, with substantial time on ML systems rather than ML research; prior experience leading an engineering effort across teams Strong CS fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, system design — plus working ML fundamentals (classification, regression, feature engineering, model evaluation) Proficiency in Python and SQL; production experience with Spark, Flink, or equivalent for streaming and batch data processing Demonstrated ownership of a data or ML platform used by more than one team, including the operational load after launch Experience deploying models to real-time serving under hard latency budgets, and running them in production afterward Cloud infrastructure depth in at least one major cloud, ideally AWS (including SageMaker or equivalent ML tooling). Comfortable owning your own footprint — IaC, CI/CD, cost — rather than filing tickets against someone else's Track record of setting technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and bringing other teams along without formal authority Strong written communication. You can put a tradeoff in front of an AI scientist, a platform owner, and a risk strategy partner in one document and have all three follow it Preferred Risk, fraud, payments, or credit domain experience, ideally in real-time decisioning Feature store or feature platform experience Entity resolution or identity graph work Experience with a rules engine and the model-to-decision handoff Regulated data handling — field-level encryption, fine-grained access control, data governance in financial services Fluency orchestrating AI agents on real engineering work, and judgment about where agent-generated output needs deterministic guardrails Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits ). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $202,500 - $274,000

jobs.description:
Why PlayStation?
PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, PlayStation®VR, PlayStation®Plus, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.
PlayStation also strives to create an inclusive environment that empowers employees and embraces diversity. We welcome and encourage everyone who has a passion and curiosity for innovation, technology, and play to explore our open positions and join our growing global team.
The PlayStation brand falls under Sony Interactive Entertainment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.
組織・チームについて
PlayStationのビジネスは、ゲームコンテンツやデジタルサービス、ハードウェア、ゲーム開発、R&Dなど、多様な領域に世界規模で広がっています。
本組織は、こうしたPlayStationビジネスの成長をFinanceの立場から支えるチームです。ゲームタイトルやパートナー取引に関するロイヤリティ、ゲーム制作・ハードウェア・R&Dに関する会計、連結・財務報告、税務、さらにはグローバルでの業務プロセス改善など、PlayStationならではの幅広いテーマに取り組んでいます。
組織はグローバル横断の組織となっており、米国・英国をはじめとする海外のAccounting / Tax / Financeチームや、ソニーグループの関係部門とも日常的に連携しています。国や地域、専門領域を越えて協働しながら、変化の大きいビジネスをFinanceの専門性で支えていく環境です。
このポジションについて
本求人は、Accounting / Tax領域におけるオープンポジションです。
特定の業務領域に限定して選考するのではなく、これまで培われてきた会計・税務の専門性、ご経験、今後のキャリア志向を踏まえ、SIEのAccounting / Tax領域における複数のポジションから、ご活躍いただける可能性を幅広く検討します。
ゲーム業界での経験や、以下に記載するすべての業務経験は必要ありません。事業会社で経理・税務に携わってきた方はもちろん、監査法人、税理士法人、Accounting Advisory等で専門性を培い、今後は事業会社の一員としてビジネスの意思決定や成長により深く関わりたい方も歓迎します。
PlayStationという多様かつ変化の大きいビジネスを舞台に、これまでの専門性を活かしながら、新たなAccounting / Tax / Finance領域へ経験を広げていただけるポジションです。
※オープンポジションのため、ご経験や募集状況に応じて、具体的なポジションのご案内までお時間をいただく場合があります。
主な業務内容
これまでのご経験や専門性、志向性に応じて、以下のような業務を担当いただくことを想定しています。
【Corporate Accounting / Reporting】
・単体・連結決算およびIFRSに基づく会計処理
・財務実績の分析および経営層・ソニーグループへのレポーティング
・監査法人対応、内部統制に関する業務
・日本・米国・欧州のFinanceチームと連携したTechnical Accountingおよび会計処理方針の検討・アラインメント
【Finance Operations / Process Improvement】
・Accounting / Tax業務におけるプロセス改善、標準化
・データ分析やAutomationを活用した業務高度化
・ERPやFinance Systemを活用した業務プロセスの改善
・AIをはじめとする新しいTechnologyを活用したFinance Operationの高度化
・為替・資金管理等のTreasury業務
・Global Finance Projectへの参画および関係部門との協働
【Business / Game & Content Accounting】
・ゲーム制作、ソフトウェア、ハードウェア、R&D等に関する会計業務
・ゲームタイトルやコンテンツに関するロイヤリティ計算、会計・税務処理
・パートナーとの取引や契約内容に基づく会計対応
・新規取引や新しいビジネスモデルに関する会計・税務面からの相談対応
【Tax】
・法人税、地方税、消費税等の申告および税務対応
・国内外の新規ビジネスや契約に関するTax Advisory
・海外Taxチーム、ソニーグループ税務チームとの連携
・Tax Risk Managementおよびグローバル税務戦略の実行支援
このポジションで得られる経験
・ハードウェア、ゲーム、デジタルサービス、R&Dなど、PlayStationならではの多様なビジネスにAccounting / Taxの専門性を活かして関わることができます。
・米国・英国をはじめとする海外Financeチームと連携し、グローバルなプロジェクトや業務改善に携わる機会があります。
・数字の処理にとどまらず、ビジネスモデルや契約の背景を理解し、Financeの専門性から課題解決や意思決定を支える経験を積むことができます。
・Accounting、Tax、Financial Reporting、Finance Transformationなど、専門性を深めると同時に、Finance領域でキャリアの幅を広げることができます。
・新しいビジネスやTechnologyの変化に伴って生まれる会計・税務上の論点に向き合い、仕組みそのものをつくる経験が得られます。
求められるスキル・経験
Accounting / Tax領域における専門性をベースに、PlayStationの多様なビジネスや新しい会計・税務テーマに関心を持ち、社内外の関係者と協働しながら業務を推進できる方を求めています。
監査法人・税理士法人・Accounting Advisory等で企業を外側から支えてきた方にとっても、これまで培った専門性を事業会社の中で活かし、ビジネスの意思決定や成長により深く関わっていただける環境です。
必須要件
以下のいずれかの領域における実務経験をお持ちの方
・事業会社における経理、決算、財務報告等の経験
・監査法人における会計監査等の経験
・税理士法人または事業会社における税務経験
・Accounting Advisory等、上記に準ずる会計・税務領域における専門経験
加えて、以下のスキル・経験をお持ちの方
・Accounting / Taxに関する基礎的な専門知識
・社内外の関係者と円滑にコミュニケーションを取り、協働しながら業務を推進できる力
※経験年数そのものではなく、これまで担当された業務内容、専門性、役割等を踏まえて総合的に検討します。
※ゲーム業界での実務経験は問いません。
歓迎要件
・日商簿記1級・2級、公認会計士、USCPA、税理士等の資格、またはそれらに相当する会計・税務知識
・IFRS、連結決算、財務報告に関する経験
・SAP / S/4HANA等のERPを使用した経験
・Excel、Power Query等を活用したデータ処理・分析経験
・AI、VBA、Automation等を活用した業務改善経験
・海外拠点や海外クライアントとの協業経験
語学力
・英語を使用するグローバルな環境で働くことに前向きであること
・実際に必要となる英語力は、担当いただくポジションによって異なります
海外のFinanceチームとのメール、チャット、ミーティング等で英語を使用する機会があります。
現時点での英語力のみで判断するのではなく、必要に応じて学びながら、グローバルな環境でコミュニケーションを取っていく意欲も重視しています。語学力向上を支援する研修制度も用意されています。
求める人物像
・Accounting / Taxの専門性を軸に、PlayStationならではの新しいビジネスや変化に関心を持ち、自らの専門領域を広げていける方
・現状のプロセスにとらわれず、より良い方法を考え、周囲を巻き込みながら改善を形にできる方
・数字や会計処理だけでなく、その背景にあるビジネスを理解し、Financeの専門性から事業の成長や意思決定に貢献したい方
・国や地域、専門性の異なるメンバーとの協働を楽しみ、互いの知見を活かしながらチームとして成果を生み出せる方
Who We Are
PlayStation operates across a diverse range of businesses, including game content, digital services, hardware, game development, and R&D, on a global scale.
Our Finance organization supports the growth of the PlayStation business through a broad range of Accounting and Tax activities. These include royalty accounting related to game titles and partner transactions, accounting for game development, hardware, and R&D, consolidated and financial reporting, tax, and global process improvement initiatives.
We work as part of a global organization, collaborating closely with Accounting, Tax, and Finance teams across the U.S., the U.K., and other regions, as well as with relevant teams across Sony Group. This is an environment where you can work across countries, functions, and areas of expertise while supporting a fast-evolving business through Finance.
Role Overview
This is an open position within our Accounting and Tax organization.
Rather than hiring for one specific role or area, we will consider opportunities across a range of Accounting and Tax positions based on your experience, areas of expertise, and future career aspirations.
Experience in the gaming industry is not required, nor do we expect candidates to have experience across every area listed below. We welcome professionals from corporate Accounting and Tax functions, as well as those who have built their expertise in audit firms, tax advisory firms, or Accounting Advisory and are looking to apply that expertise more directly within a business.
This is an opportunity to bring your Accounting or Tax expertise into the diverse and evolving PlayStation business while expanding your experience into new areas across Finance.
Please note that, as this is an open position, it may take some time to identify and introduce a specific opportunity depending on your background and current hiring needs.
What You'll Be Doing
Depending on your experience, expertise, and career interests, you may be considered for responsibilities such as the following.
【Corporate Accounting / Reporting】
・Support standalone and consolidated closing processes and accounting treatment under IFRS
・Analyze financial performance and prepare reporting for management and Sony Group
・Support external audit and internal control activities
・Collaborate with Finance teams in Japan, the U.S., and Europe on Technical Accounting matters and alignment of accounting policies and treatment
【Finance Operations / Process Improvement】
・Drive process improvement and standardization across Accounting and Tax operations
・Enhance Finance processes through data analysis and automation
・Improve workflows through the use of ERP and Finance systems
・Explore and implement new technologies, including AI, to improve Finance operations
・Support Treasury activities, including foreign exchange and cash management
・Participate in global Finance projects and cross-functional initiatives
【Business / Game & Content Accounting】
・Support accounting for game development, software, hardware, R&D, and related business areas
・Manage royalty calculations and related accounting and tax treatment for game titles and content
・Provide accounting support for partner transactions and contractual arrangements
・Advise on accounting and tax matters related to new transactions and emerging business models
【Tax】
・Support corporate tax, local tax, consumption tax, and related tax compliance activities
・Provide Tax Advisory support for new domestic and international business initiatives and contracts
・Collaborate with overseas Tax teams and Sony Group Tax teams
・Support Tax Risk Management and execution of global tax initiatives
Why Join Us
・Apply your Accounting or Tax expertise across a diverse portfolio of PlayStation businesses, including hardware, games, digital services, and R&D
・Work closely with Finance teams in the U.S., the U.K., and other regions on global projects and process improvement initiatives
・Go beyond transaction processing by understanding business models and commercial arrangements, and help support decision-making through your Finance expertise
・Deepen your expertise while expanding your career across areas such as Accounting, Tax, Financial Reporting, and Finance Transformation
・Gain experience addressing new accounting and tax considerations created by evolving business models and technologies, and help shape the processes and frameworks that support them
What We're Looking For
We are looking for professionals with a strong foundation in Accounting or Tax who are interested in working across a wide range of PlayStation businesses and new Finance topics, and who can collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
Candidates coming from audit firms, tax advisory firms, or Accounting Advisory backgrounds are also welcome. This is an opportunity to bring your technical expertise in-house and become more directly involved in business decision-making and growth.
You should have experience in at least one of the following areas:
・Corporate accounting, financial closing, or financial reporting
・Audit experience at an accounting or audit firm
・Tax experience within a tax advisory firm or corporate environment
・Accounting Advisory or other comparable Accounting or Tax expertise
In addition, we are looking for:
・Foundational technical knowledge in Accounting and/or Tax
・Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with a wide range of stakeholders
We assess candidates based on the scope and depth of their experience rather than years of experience alone.
Experience in the gaming industry is not required.
Preferred Skills
・Bookkeeping, CPA, USCPA, tax accountant, or other relevant Accounting or Tax qualifications, or equivalent knowledge
・Experience with IFRS, consolidated accounting, or financial reporting
・Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP or S/4HANA
・Experience using Excel, Power Query, or similar tools for data processing and analysis
・Experience improving processes through AI, VBA, automation, or related technologies
・Experience working with overseas offices, global teams, or international clients
・Willingness to work in an environment where English is used regularly; the level of English required will vary depending on the specific role
You may use English in emails, chat, meetings, and other communications with overseas Finance teams. We value not only your current English proficiency, but also your willingness to continue developing your skills and communicate effectively in a global environment. Language development support is also available.
Ideal Candidate
・You are motivated to build on your Accounting or Tax expertise while expanding into new business and Finance areas
・You look for ways to improve existing processes and can work with others to turn ideas into practical improvements
・You are interested in understanding the business behind the numbers and using your Finance expertise to support business growth and decision-making
・You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across countries, regions, and areas of expertise, and value achieving results as a team

All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.
We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.
PlayStation is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.
